content: We represent each review as a vector of TF-IDF scores for each word in the review. The length of this vector is $10,867$. We label each review vector with the car it reviews. We ignore the year of the car being reviewed and focus specifically on the model (i.e Acura ILX, not 2013 Acura ILX). This is because there a single model of car generally retains the same characteristics over time BIBREF11, BIBREF12.
